26 players
3R+F
vekn.net/index.php/event-calendar/event/7044
Winner: Pascal Bertrand

decklist:
DEckname: Tribute to Denis "Richter" who ousted me with a similar deck.

// Finished during the evening before the event, at 2AM. I realized it was missing some key cards during the rounds.

2 Sheldon - Lord of the Clog - 9 for ANI AUS OBF POT Justicar
2 Selma - the Repugnant - 8 ani for OBF POT Prince
2 Murat - 7 ser OBF POT Prince
2 Nikolaus Vermeulen - 7 ani for obf POT Prince
1 Tusk, the Talebearer - 6 ani pot OBF
1 Calebros, the Martyr - 5 obf pot ANI Prince
1 Agrippina - 4 pot OBF
1 Dimple - 2 obf

// Crypt comments: With no crypt acceleration, Murat is likely to be the best vampire of the crypt. That Tusk could become a Murat.

Master
1 The Coven
1 Archon Investigation
1 Slum Hunting Ground
1 The Secret Library of Alexandria
1 Warsaw Station
1 Pentex Subversion
1 The Labyrinth
2 Blood Doll

// The best one on that list is the Secret Library. Its cycling power is beyond imagination.
// There is also no crypt accelerator. Well, there should probably, but not as master cards

Action
9 Third Tradition: Progeny
2 Fifth Tradition: Hospitality

// That's where the crypt acceleration should be. Some Fourth trads could only help. ShreckNET is also sort of mandatory here...

Political Action
8 Kine Resources Contested
2 Domain Challenge
1 Parity Shift
3 Conservative Agitation
7 Consanguineous Boon

// A couple of extra Parity Shifts and some better votes would simply make the deck better. Neonate Breach, Banishment, …

Action Modifiers
6 Cloak the Gathering
2 Elder Impersonation
3 Faceless Night
2 Forgotten Labyrinth
4 Lost in Crowds
3 Veil the Legion
1 Old Friends
3 Swallowed by the Night

// Perhaps one or two Freak Drives?

Reaction
9 Mental Maze
10 Second Tradition: Domain
